diagnostics.message: `aws_launch_template.this` only has `depends_on = [aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.this]`, but the node IAM role also gets policies attached via `aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.additional`. There is no attribute reference or `depends_on` establishing that ordering, so the launch template (and the ASG/instances it feeds) can be created before the additional policies are attached to the role. Instances launched from this template then come up with a role missing those additional permissions — exactly the "premature access of policies by pods that depend on nodes" scenario the existing `depends_on` on `.this` was added to prevent. `aws_iam_role_policy_attachment.additional` should be added to that same `depends_on` list.
